# 1118

> Original products, built from ideas we believe should exist. We create web platforms, apps, and specialized software—mostly our own. We partner occasionally. When the idea is sharp, the problem is real, and we believe the product should exist.

Canonical website: https://1118.io/

## Products and work
- [Portrait](https://1118.io/work/portrait): A 1118 product that turns a clear photograph into an editorial portrait, ready for profiles, websites, social media, and print.
- [Reviews Engine](https://1118.io/#reviews-engine): Software for collecting, moderating, and publishing customer reviews.
- [Property Insights](https://1118.io/#property-insights): Property context, risk, and recommendations assembled before an estimate begins.
- [Signal](https://1118.io/work/signal): Commodities analytics software designed and built by 1118, used in live markets, licensed commercially, and later acquired.
- [Selected work](https://1118.io/work): Portrait and Signal case studies.
